usage: 甜 (tim4) describes the taste of something sugary or pleasant.
Use 甜 to talk about fruits and desserts to indicate they taste sweet.
It can describe natural sweetness or added sugar in food.
Sometimes 甜 is used to describe a sweet smell, but mostly the taste.
甜 contrasts with 苦 (bitter), 酸 (sour), and 鹹 (salty) when describing flavors.
